newsitem.title: USA: Harman says Chrysler strike to cut Q4 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Harman says Chrysler strike to cut Q4 EPS.

text.p: Harman International Industries Inc said Monday the strike at Chrysler Corp's Mound Road engine plant in Detroit would lower Harman's earnings in the fiscal fourth quarter by $0.15 per share.

The company, a maker of high-fidelity audio products, said Chrysler's loss of production of about 95,000 vehicles during the month-long strike resulted in a corresponding reduction in shipments of its Infinity audio systems.
Harman said it had hoped to recover some of the production in the quarter, but said Chrysler advised that few if any of the lost units would be recovered.
